Players Committee card image of [[Ahch-To: Saddle]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “'''Light Side:''' May ▼ [Episode VII] Luke here. Once per turn, if Luke alone here, may subtract 2 from opponent's total power during a battle at another location.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/ahchtosaddle.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/ahchtosaddle.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
